notes.title: Update: v1.3.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/55c70610203f4d6762e112cd9a5e3aee37b8b4ec.gif[/img]

It's been a while since the last update! Here's what's been changed:
[list]
[*] Blobert is now stronger. Enemies caught within his landing-radius get destroyed.
[*] Coin screen wrapping fix (God of Wealth)
[*] Level selection UI fix
[/list]

[b]For mac users, if you're facing issues running the game after the update, please uninstall and reinstall the game.[/b]

Happy scrambling and don't forget to leave a review if you haven't already! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Character Added: God of Wealth (v1.3.0.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/43d71e0786adc12633e85859330a33a0d2e3b7b3.png[/img]

Happy Lunar New Year!
Here's what we have for the v.1.3.0.0 update!
[list]
[*] God of Wealth - new character
[*] Shoulder buttons can now be used to navigate the character
[/list]

[h1]About God of Wealth[/h1]

The God of Wealth is here! With this new jolly character, you'll be able to get even more coins (more than Mummy!). In addition to that, any nearby coins get immediately sucked in - so you're unlikely to miss any coins!



[i]Don't forget to drop a review if you haven't already done so :)[/i]

notes.title: New Character Added: Merlion (v1.1.0.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/58487563237035afa958bcd5feabd3197cd80e3e.gif[/img]

Hello again!
Here's what we have for the v1.1.0.0 update!
[list]
[*] Merlion - new character
[*] Shifted screen wrapping instructions to an earlier level
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]About Merlion[/h1]
Half lion, half fish, the Merlion is here to join the cast of quirky characters in Serious Scramblers! Merlion comes equipped with a fire-proof shield for those of us who have troubles with those pesky fire-platforms!

[b]Character features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire-proof shield
[*] Level scrolls faster
[*] Falls faster
[/list]
